# A.F.G Marble & Arts

> Generational master sculptors of bespoke Makrana marble temples, palatial cascading fountains, royal garden chhatris, and sacred pooja room architecture since 1987. Official atelier in Jaipur & Makrana, Rajasthan, India.

## About the Atelier
- **Founded:** 1987 in Makrana & Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.
- **Craft Tradition:** Four generations of hereditary master stone sculptors (Shilpkars) specializing in Rajasthani sacred architecture and Mughal-era Pietra Dura lapidary stonecraft.
- **Flagship Experience Hub:** Near MI Road / C-Scheme, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302001, India.
- **Quarry & Carving Workshop:** Industrial Stone Artisan Zone, Makrana, Rajasthan 341505, India.
- **Direct Concierge:** Phone: +91 7597417274 | WhatsApp: +91 7597417274
- **Official Website:** https://afgmarbel.com

## Core Architectural Offerings
1. **Bespoke Marble Mandirs & Home Temples:**
   - Hand-chiselled from monolithic blocks of Grade-1 certified Makrana Dungri & Albeta pure white calcite marble (the exact stone quarried for the Taj Mahal and Victoria Memorial).
   - Designed strictly compliant with ancient Ayadi calculations, Agamic proportions, and Vastu Shastra principles.
   - Features: Intricate Mughal and Nagara style jaali lattices, multi-tiered shikhars, fluted colonnades, carved Kalash domes, concealed warm LED illumination, and under-pedestal storage drawers for puja samagri.
2. **Palatial Tiered Fountains & Courtyard Watercraft:**
   - Classical scalloped lotus basins, multi-tiered estate fountains, lion-head spout wall fountains, and modern minimalist floating sphere fountains.
   - Engineered for private villas, palace hotels, embassies, and luxury estates worldwide.
3. **Royal Rajasthani Chhatris & Garden Pavilions:**
   - Octagonal and hexagonal carved pavilions with fluted domes, ornamental brackets, peacock arches, and perimeter stone balustrades.
4. **Pietra Dura (Parchin Kari) Inlays & Stone Jali Screens:**
   - Authentic semi-precious stone inlays using genuine lapis lazuli, malachite, carnelian, jasper, and mother-of-pearl set into hand-cut recesses in pure white marble.

## Sourcing & Material Specifications
- **Makrana Pure White Marble:** 99% pure calcium carbonate (calcite crystal structure). Non-porous, zero water absorption, immune to puja oil/milk staining, never turns yellow over centuries.
- **Exotic Stone Library:** Italian Calacatta Oro, Botticino Classico, Nero Marquina, Ambaji White, Translucent Green Onyx, and Rajasthan Bansi Paharpur Pink Sandstone.

## Global Logistics & Turnkey Assembly
- Over 40% of all commissions are safely exported to private estates and temples in the USA, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Canada, Australia, and Europe.
- Packaging: Precision-numbered disassembled modules, vacuum-sealed in waterproof moisture barriers, secured inside heavy-duty, fumigated ISPM-15 export certified timber crates.
- Turnkey Rigging: On-site supervision by master Indian sculptors for international assembly, masonry anchoring, and consecration.
